note: duration_min = ended − started − paused, never negative, rounded to whole minutes; null for an unparseable instant or a finish before the start. LONG-IDLE GUARD: a last set more than 20 minutes before the finish (strictly more — 20 is still training) means the tail was not training, and the answer becomes the work plus one rest (the movement's restTargetSec, else 180s), never longer than the uncapped answer. A last set outside [started, ended] is ignored. This is what the 385-minute Sept 6 session was missing on both clients.
